messages:
Nora: Heads-up  I'm opening a tiny docs PR to replace a couple deprecated airgap helper scripts with a single vetted importer and add a short troubleshooting section for PKCS#11 socket perms and conntrack limits. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4922
Ben: Nice. Please add a short row in the port matrix for PKCS#11 (TCP 5696) and call out NTP (UDP 123). Also include a one-liner for restricting SSH in airgapped mode (only maintenance bastion).
Kofi: Security check: include notes to set PKCS#11 socket perms to 660 and to disable core dumps for the service user. Small snippet to add:
```
# socket perms + ulimit disable core dumps
chown redwood:pkcs11 /var/run/pkcs11.sock
chmod 660 /var/run/pkcs11.sock
# disable core dumps for redwood
echo 'redwood hard core 0' >> /etc/security/limits.conf
```
Asha: For busy installs we should add conntrack/sysctl guidance. Suggest this minimal example:
```
sysctl -w net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max=220000
sysctl -w net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_tcp_timeout_established=300
```
Nora: Good catches. I'm also adding two tiny firewall fallbacks (nftables + iptables) for customers who can't use nftables yet. Keep them intentionally minimal.
Ben: Suggest I add the nftables snippet like this:
```
table inet redwood {
  chain input { type filter hook input priority 0; policy drop; }
  chain input {
    iifname "lo" accept
    tcp dport {443,5696} accept
  }
}
```
Ben: And an iptables fallback (single line): `iptables -A INPUT -i lo -j ACCEPT; iptables -A INPUT -p tcp -m multiport --dports 443,5696 -j ACCEPT; iptables -P INPUT DROP`
Kofi: Also add a short SELinux hint: `semanage fcontext -a -t pkcs11_socket_t '/var/run/pkcs11.sock' && restorecon -v /var/run/pkcs11.sock'` (only if SELinux is enabled).
Asha: I will add a tiny offline-import systemd unit + one-shot script sample for the new importer (weekly timer). Keep it minimal in docs; ops can copy/paste. Draft script in PR will be cleaned.
Nora: UX asks: 1) add a small TOC anchors list at the top (Ports / Firewall fallback / Offline import / Troubleshooting); 2) fix the installer checklist link that was pointing at the wrong anchor (#network-check -> #networking-check).
DocsBot: docs-preview: build completed for PR #4922  preview: https://deploy-preview.docs.redwood-inference.internal/4922/ :white_check_mark:
Ben: I'll push the port table + nft/iptables commits shortly.
Kofi: I'll add wording for not hammering PKCS#11 on startup (recommend exponential backoff with jitter). Short phrasing: "Use exponential backoff with jitter for PKCS#11 retries to avoid overloading HSM appliances during bulk operations."
Asha: Uploaded the systemd timer & importer in a follow-up commit.
Nora: Thanks  please do a quick review today so I can merge and link this from the private deployment index. :eyes:
Ben: Reviewing now, small wording tweaks incoming.
Kofi: LGTM on security wording once the SELinux snippet is in.
Nora: Merging after small fixes. Will announce in #docs when live. :thumbsup:
